projects.heading: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Real projects spanning AI, software, embedded systems, and IoT.
projects.proj0Desc: A heavy-duty 6-wheel autonomous agricultural rover using Raspberry Pi for crop-row navigation, sensor-based row detection, grid mapping, plant position identification, autonomous stopping, micro-environment comparison, solar-assisted power management, and LoRa communication.
projects.proj1Desc: A low-cost patient-care prototype using a load cell and HX711 to measure saline depletion, with Arduino Uno and ESP32 integration, wireless alert transmission, and automated threshold-based alerts.
projects.proj2Desc: A webcam-based system that analyzes chest motion to estimate breath-hold duration, with automatic timing/history tracking and prompt engineering with AI tools.
projects.proj3Desc: An end-to-end supervised ML pipeline using KNN, Logistic Regression, and Naive Bayes, with EDA, feature engineering, Precision/Recall/F1 evaluation, Bayes-based repayment likelihood, and an interactive eligibility interface.

experience.exp0Description:
Contributing as a technical member of AGRHI HUB, working around practical engineering and IoT projects.
